name: Compounder StrategyDAICurve permissionless deposit manipulation
summary: StrategyDAICurve exposed a permissionless deposit() that converted its entire loose DAI balance and added the resulting yDAI to Curve with every minimum-output amount set to zero. The attacker imbalanced Curve, routed 40,000 DAI into the strategy through Compounder's share-accounting flow, and forced this unslippaged deposit before reversing the Curve trades for a net DAI profit.
notes: Direct deployment of the StrategyDAICurve runtime executed in the exploit.

The successful transaction ends with an exact 27,146.693493638241032728 DAI transfer to the attacker EOA. This is the attacker's net revenue from the composed Compounder and Curve sequence, valued at DAI's one-dollar par value.
